notes:
Agent conversations: Answer questions in cards, review plans and choose an access mode. Question options can include media previews; desktop notifications flag sessions needing attention or finished work.
Session management: Fork completed turns, import Claude Code and Codex sessions, schedule sessions, search conversations and load earlier messages. Organize sessions by status and mark them unread.
Agent visibility: View task lists, context compaction, tool details and nested subagent steps. Background jobs can wake an agent when they finish; Claude background tasks stay alive while idle.
Agent settings: Add custom instructions and use updated skills in existing sessions. Agents can receive context about your own recent video edits.
Text and media: Enable Claude Code as a text generation provider. A new vlog-from-clips skill helps turn raw footage into a vlog. Short YuE2 music requests now work.
Providers and tools: Improved compatibility with custom image endpoints and their returned image formats. Install and update the managed yt-dlp tool from BaoCut.
Bot mode is experimental and hidden by default; its channels, tasks and automation require the features.bot setting to be enabled explicitly.
Requirements and verification limits: macOS packages require Apple Silicon and macOS 14+ and are signed and notarized. Windows CPU, CUDA and Vulkan packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable; GPU variants require compatible drivers. ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine remain external dependencies. Electron 44.9.3 embeds Node 24.22.0 and does not include the October Node security fixes. Automated checks do not cover full UI/export workflows, live model or GPU inference, physical IME candidate windows or paid agent calls.
